literal_meaning: হাট (বাজার) করা (to make or do a market)
figurative_meaning_en: To make disorganized, haphazard, or chaotic
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঘরের জিনিসপত্র হাট করে ছড়িয়ে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The books are lying scattered about.
The household items have been thrown into disarray.
note: Derived from the imagery of a bustling village market (হাট) where goods are spread out haphazardly.
